name: gephi-ai
description: Control Gephi with AI: 113 tools for network analysis plus an interactive in-chat graph viewer.
long_description: Connects Claude to Gephi Desktop through the Model Context Protocol: build, analyze, lay out, style, and export network graphs, run community detection and centrality, and render an interactive in-chat visualization (pan, zoom, cluster captions, time slider, ask-Claude-about-a-node). Requires Gephi Desktop with the Gephi AI (MCP) plugin installed and running (https://github.com/MattArtzAnthro/gephi-ai).
